topic: The Attention Mechanism: How Transformers Read

sections.title: The Core Problem: Contextual Ambiguity
lecture_lines: Previous models processed words only linearly.
This misses dependencies across long distances.
Ambiguity arises when words shift meaning.
animations: Create text 'Word Ambiguity' in #FFFFFF color alongside [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dictionary.svg].
Display two similar words with changing highlights in #FFD700.
Add directional arrows #00FFFF between context and word, incorporating [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pen.svg] to signify the analysis process.

sections.title: The Intuition: Query, Key, and Value (QKV)
lecture_lines: We treat retrieval like a search system.
Queries ask for what we need.
Values contain the actual information content.
animations: Show Query vector #FF0000 targeting specific Key #00FF00 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/magnifyingglass.svg].
Reveal Value vector #0000FF associated with that key.
Animate vector projection #FFFFFF for interaction visualization using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/document.svg].

sections.title: The Math: Visualizing Attention Weights
lecture_lines: Softmax normalizes these scores to weights.
animations: Display matrix multiplication WQ * X in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Self-Attention in Action
lecture_lines: All words attend to each other simultaneously.
The model links related words directly.
animations: Parallel heads visualized as stacked layers in #FF0000,#00FF00,#0000FF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/brain.svg].
Merge vectors into single final representation in #FFD700 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/network.svg].

sections.title: Synthesis: From Mechanism to LLMs
lecture_lines: Layers transform inputs into complex vectors.
These vectors capture deep semantic meaning.
